android.desc:
G7 Taxi is the leading taxi-booking app in Paris and the Île-de-France region.

Book your taxi in just one click on your smartphone and access a network of 10,000 taxi drivers who have been carefully selected and trained to G7’s high standards of service.

Booking a G7, for an immediate departure or a booking in advance, that suits your needs, has never been easier:

- Launch the app; your location is automatically detected. Enter the number of passengers to receive the most suitable service, tap on "now" tbook a G7 where you are, or "later" for a request up to 30 days in advance


- You can also enter your pick-up address manually using the auto-complete feature or access your favourites list. If you enter your destination address, you’ll receive an estimate of the journey time and fare.

- Choose your preferred service from a wide range of options:
 * G7: Simplicity and efficiency
 * G7 Green: Europe’s leading eco-friendly fleet with 7,800 hybrid or electric vehicles
 * G7 Van: for journeys with up to 7 passengers
 * G7 VIP: luxury saloons (Mercedes E-Class or equivalent), hand-picked drivers, a range of on-board services and priority handling of your booking.
 * G7 Van VIP: for up to 7 passengers with VIP comfort and services
 * G7 Family: booster seats and baby seats
 * G7 Coffre+: bulky luggage
 * G7 Access Standard: low-floor taxis for passengers with reduced mobility
 * G7 Access Boot+: low-floor taxis with a large boot
 * G7 Access Ramp: taxis for passengers with reduced mobility with an access ramp

- You can customise your booking with options tailored to your specific needs:
 * Partition
 * English-speaking driver
 * Pet on board
 * Baby seats and booster seats
 * Third party payers

- Choose your payment method directly from the app (on registered credit card) or on board with your driver
- You can also leave specific instructions to your driver
- Follow the arrival of your taxi in real time on the map with the possibility of being put in direct contact with your driver
- Easily locate your taxi thanks tthe display of useful information (vehicle registration, brand and colour)
- Once the trip is over, you can evaluate the trip.The G7 Taxi application is also:
- G7 Connect ! Take a G7 on the street and pay with your app!
